//! MR-009b Wave 0 OVER-BROADENING GUARD fixture — the same shape as
//! `no_in_memory_durable_store.test_support.green.rs.txt` but with the gate REMOVED. It must STILL
//! BITE: if the Wave-0 enhancement ever admits this, it over-broadened and let a REAL production
//! in-memory store through. The in-memory arm here is the always-compiled production default.
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

/// UN-gated in-memory backing — the always-compiled default (no `test-support`, no `#[cfg(test)]`).
struct Inner {
    partitions: HashMap<(String, String), BTreeMap<String, TupleRow>>,
}

pub enum TupleBackend {
    Memory(Arc<Mutex<Inner>>),
    Pg(PgTupleBacking),
}

/// A durable-by-contract *Store whose in-memory `Memory(Inner)` arm is UN-gated — STILL FIRES (red).
pub struct TupleStore {
    backend: TupleBackend,
}

/// An UN-gated in-memory *Store — the production system-of-record on a map with no pool — FIRES.
pub struct PrincipalStore {
    inner: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, PrincipalRow>>>,
}
